mappings.rationale: Strong password policy with complexity, periodic change and reuse prevention is required for SWIFT-related accounts; IAC-10.1 enforces complexity, length and lifespan criteria for password-based authentication and IAC-10 is the surrounding authenticator management that keeps authentication strength matched to the data being accessed.

Operator access to SWIFT applications and systems must require at least two independent authentication factors, which IAC-06 discharges directly by enforcing multi-factor authentication for remote and non-console access to critical systems.
